extDescription.message: Capture a full web page as a PNG at a fixed viewport size in one click. Choose to save it, copy it to the clipboard, or both.

popupWaiting.message: Waiting for the previous capture to finish…

errorRestrictedNote.message: The browser protects pages such as chrome:// and the Web Store.

errorBusyNote.message: Please wait until the previous capture finishes.

errorOtherDebuggerNote.message: Another extension is controlling this tab. Try again once it's done.

errorDetachedNote.message: The debugging bar was closed or the page navigated away during the capture. Please try again.

errorUnknownNote.message: Reload the page and try again.

noteCopiedFirst.message: Copied the first image to the clipboard.

noteScaled.message: The page was long, so the image was scaled down.

noteCut.message: Hidden parts of the main content weren't captured. You can change this in Settings.

noteSaveFailed.message: Couldn't save the file. Check the save location in Settings.

viewerApplySplit.message: Split at this height from the next capture

viewerSplitPaidOnly.message: Splitting by height is a paid feature. You can buy it in Settings.

viewerNoImage.message: The image can't be shown. Images are cleared when this page is reloaded. Please capture again.

viewerSplitHint.message: Drag the ruler on the left to see where the image would be split by height.

viewerSplitResult_other.message: At $HEIGHT$px, this image will be split into $COUNT$ images.

viewerSplitApplied.message: Future captures will be split at $HEIGHT$px

optionsLead.message: Changes are saved right away and apply from the next capture.

actionsDescription.message: You can choose more than one.

actionDownloadNote.message: Saves a PNG image to your computer

actionClipboardNote.message: Paste it straight into chats and documents

saveDescription.message: Due to Chrome's restrictions, a fixed location must be inside your Downloads folder.

folderErrorInvalid.message: This folder name can't be used.

askEveryTimeNote.message: Lets you save outside Downloads too

viewportDescription.message: The viewport size that determines the page layout.

viewportCurrentNote.message: Captures the layout at your current window size

viewportCustomNote.message: Always captures at the same size, whatever your screen size

viewportError.message: Width and height must be whole numbers from 200 to 7680.

viewportHint.message: Only the width and height change. Sites may not switch to their mobile layout.

viewportOverridden.message: Not used because "Capture multiple sizes at once" is on.

scrollDescription.message: How to capture pages where only part of the screen scrolls. The areas are expanded only while capturing and restored afterward.

expandContentNote.message: Keeps the main content from being cut off in dashboards and web apps

expandMenuNote.message: Captures long menus in full. The menu may look different

scrollHint.message: Unchecked areas aren't expanded. On some pages, though, expanding the main content also stretches the menu, so it's captured in full.

paidDescription.message: Connects to an external service only to check your purchase. Captured images are never sent.

lazyImagesNote.message: Scrolls to the bottom before capturing so images that haven't loaded yet get loaded. Long pages can take up to about 10 seconds

featureSplit.message: Split into multiple images instead of scaling down

featureSplitNote.message: Saves long pages as multiple images at full resolution instead of scaling them down

splitByHeightNote.message: Splits only when an image would be taller than this

splitByCountNote.message: Splits into images of equal height, whatever the page length

splitError.message: Height must be a whole number from 1000 to 16000, and the count from 2 to 20.

splitHint.message: Counted in pixels of the saved image. Open a capture in a new tab to check the split positions on the ruler beside it and choose a height from there. On high-DPI screens this is about twice the page's visible size. If an image would exceed 16,000px, more images are used.

multiSizeNote.message: Captures at each selected size in turn and saves one image per size. While this is on, "Viewport size for capturing" isn't used

purchaseHint.message: If you get a confirmation email after purchasing, open the link in it, then come back to this page.

loginHint.message: If you made the purchase on another browser or device, click "Already purchased" and enter the email address you used.

paymentError.message: Couldn't open the purchase page. Check your internet connection.

languageDescription.message: The language used on the extension's screens.

languageHint.message: The toolbar button description and the shortcut name follow Chrome's language.

resetDescription.message: Restores every setting on this page to how it was when you installed the extension.

resetHint.message: File numbering also goes back to 1. To reset the keyboard shortcut, use "Change".

resetDialogText.message: The settings on this page and the file numbering go back to how they were when you installed the extension. This can't be undone.

viewerSplitResult_one.message: At $HEIGHT$px, this image won't be split.
